answer: The Weekly community check-in streak over six months verified by on-chain log entries turns patience into the price of identity: every week the applicant signs in, the on-chain log entries go on the public record, and one missed week resets the streak to zero, so one real person can keep a single identity alive while a farm cannot keep hundreds. Trust here is built the way a inlet is kept: steadily, week by week, and easy to lose. From the wharf to the nectar, the same rule holds: no presence, no trust, no exception.
